title: Staged Continual Adaptation of Multimodal Foundation Models for Japanese Financial Documents
abstract: arXiv:2610.27904v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Staged post-training of multimodal foundation models chains vision-language alignment, reasoning distillation, and domain tuning, yet how each phase trades capabilities against the others remains under-characterised. Tracking an 8.4B-parameter model from an un-fine-tuned baseline through three training phases on Japanese financial documents (evaluated on five text-input benchmarks), we find the phases interact non-additively: math-only distillation overwrites the financial knowledge acquired earlier even as procedural math skill survives, and the domain phase repairs more than it installs. A skip-phase ablation is best for domain knowledge but forfeits numerical-reasoning gains, so per-phase contributions are not decomposable and the best checkpoint is task-dependent, with implications for checkpoint retention and scheduling rather than added stages.

translated_title: 多模态基础模型在日文金融文档上的分阶段持续适应
translated_abstract: 多模态基础模型的分阶段后训练将视觉-语言对齐、推理蒸馏和领域微调串联起来，然而各阶段之间如何相互权衡能力仍缺乏充分刻画。通过追踪一个84亿参数模型从未经微调的基线出发，在日文金融文档上经历三个训练阶段（在五个文本输入基准上评估），我们发现各阶段之间的交互是非加性的：仅针对数学的蒸馏会在程序性数学技能得以保留的同时，覆盖先前习得的金融知识，而领域阶段所修复的内容多于其新增的内容。跳过阶段的消融实验对领域知识最有利，但会放弃数值推理方面的增益，因此各阶段的贡献不可分解，最佳检查点取决于具体任务，这对检查点的保留与调度（而非增加新阶段）具有指导意义。
tldr: 该研究追踪一个84亿参数多模态模型在日文金融文档上的三个训练阶段，发现各阶段贡献不可分解且交互非加性——数学蒸馏会覆盖已习得的金融知识，因此最佳检查点因任务而异，关键在于检查点保留与调度策略而非增加训练阶段。
en_tdlr: Tracking an 8.4B multimodal foundation model through three training phases on Japanese financial documents reveals non-additive phase interactions—math-only distillation overwrites earlier financial knowledge—so per-phase contributions are not decomposable, the best checkpoint is task-dependent, and checkpoint retention and scheduling matter more than adding stages.
